summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Student Assistant app. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases PASSED including LLM-heavy endpoints (capture, import with real JPEG schedule image, notes/generate, search, weekly-review). Frontend: all screens render (Home briefing, Timeline, Review, Profile/'You', Notes, Search, Import). ONE critical navigation bug found: the center + FAB does not open the Capture modal because router.push('/capture') resolves to the tab route (tabs)/capture.tsx which just Redirects back to home. Direct URL navigation to /capture works fine and the modal itself is functional.

ui_bugs.issue: FAB tap does not open the Capture modal. router.push('/capture') is intercepted by app/(tabs)/capture.tsx which does <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />, so the user stays on Home. The root /app/capture.tsx modal is unreachable from the FAB.

integration_issues.issue: Users cannot reach the capture screen via the primary FAB entry point, effectively breaking the app's headline flow. Only workaround is a manual URL /capture. Backend /api/capture itself is working (validated end-to-end).

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be addressed for RN new arch.

action_items: Fix FAB navigation: either (a) delete /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/capture.tsx and set the Tabs.Screen for capture to href:null (or remove it) so /capture resolves to the root modal, or (b) rename the modal route (e.g. /quick-capture) and update router.push in (tabs)/_layout.tsx accordingly.
Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style prop across the theme/components.
critical_code_review_comments: Route collision: both /app/frontend/app/capture.tsx and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/capture.tsx exist. Because tab groups are transparent, expo-router prefers the tab version, breaking the intended modal push. Only one should own the /capture path.
backend/server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in Starlette; consider FastAPI lifespan handlers.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (5/6 primary flows – capture broken via FAB)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed tasks/events/notes and clean up. A TestPrivacy.test_wipe at end wipes all DB collections. Also created via UI: one 'TEST_UI_note' (removed by wipe test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~50s and hits real LLM endpoints. Use BASE_URL https://semester-sync-7.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend Profile tab label is 'You' not 'Profile'. Timeline filter chips render as plain Text (few explicit selectors). The Capture modal at /app/capture.tsx works when navigated directly (goto /capture); the bug is exclusively in FAB routing.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: Load app -> tap the central + FAB. Expected: Capture modal opens with capture-input visible. Actual: URL remains '/', no modal, no navigation event visible. Root cause: (tabs)/_layout.tsx registers a Tabs.Screen name='capture' backed by (tabs)/capture.tsx (which just Redirects to '/(tabs)'). When the FAB calls router.push('/capture'), expo-router matches the tab route (tabs)/capture instead of the root modal /app/capture.tsx, triggering the Redirect and returning the user to Home. Mitigation options: (1) Delete (tabs)/capture.tsx AND remove its Tabs.Screen entry, replacing tabBarButton with a floating Pressable rendered outside the Tabs; (2) Keep the placeholder tab but set options={{ href: null }} so no route is created, then delete (tabs)/capture.tsx; (3) Rename the modal path (e.g. app/quick-capture.tsx) and update router.push accordingly.
